description: This file defines the internal class SQSAdapterReceiver which implements IQueueAdapterReceiver for receiving and processing messages from an Amazon SQS queue within the Orleans streaming framework. It handles initialization, message retrieval, and message acknowledgment, utilizing serialization and logging components.

classes.name: SQSAdapterReceiver
classes.description: An internal implementation of IQueueAdapterReceiver that manages message reception and deletion from an Amazon SQS queue, supporting initialization and shutdown procedures within Orleans.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate a new SQSAdapterReceiver with provided serializer, loggerFactory, queueId, data connection string, and service ID.

methods.name: Shutdown
methods.description: Performs an orderly shutdown of the receiver, awaiting pending tasks and nullifying the queue reference.

methods.name: GetQueueMessagesAsync
methods.description: Retrieves messages from the queue up to maxCount, deserializes them into IBatchContainer instances, and returns the list.

methods.name: MessagesDeliveredAsync
methods.description: Acknowledges delivery of messages by deleting them from the queue, handling exceptions during deletion.
